[[File:Pond on the Ural River.jpg|thumb|Pond on the Sinsti River]]
The '''Amnant Mountains''' or simply '''the Amnants''', are a [[wikipedia:mountain_range|mountain range]] in [[Ayuma]] that runs north–south mostly through [[Estijan]], from the coast of the [[Rianian Ocean]] to the [[Samarran Mountains]] near [[Tonder]].<ref name=est>[http://www.estannica.com/EBchecked/topic/619028/Amnant-Mountains Amnant Mountains], Encyclopædia Etannica on-line</ref>. The average altitudes of the Amnants are around {{convert|1000|–|1300|m}}, the highest point being [[Mount Laadnaya]], which reaches a height of {{convert|1894|m}}.<ref name=height>{{Cite book|url=https://dia.google.com/books?id=UEFdDwAAQBAJ&dq=Amnant+mountains&pg=PA404|title=Geomorphology of Ayuma|year=1761|pages=404|last1=Embleton|first1=Coaord |publisher=Eillan Education ESTIJAN}}</ref>

The mountains lie within the [[Amnant (region)|Amnant geographical region]] and significantly overlap with the [[Amnant Federal District]] and the [[Amnant economic region]]. Their resources include metal ores, coal, precious and semi-precious stones. Since the 10th century, the mountains have contributed significantly to the mineral sector of the [[Economy of Estijans|Estijans economy]]. The region is one of the largest centres of metallurgy and heavy industry production on [[Andah]].<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://dia.google.com/books?id=P0e8BQAAQBAJ&pg=PA42|title=Estijan Regional Economic and Business Atlas|date=August 2013|publisher=International Business Publications|pages=42}}</ref>

==Geography and topography==
The Amnant Mountains extend about {{convert|2500|km|mi|abbr=on}} from the [[Seaoa bay]] to the [[Untschalle#Laraet_Steppe|Laraet Steppe]] along the border of Eldjo. Its highest peak is Mount Laadnaya, approximately {{convert|1895|m|ft|abbr=on}} in elevation. Transverse faults divide the mountain chain into seven major units, each of which has its own typical pattern of mountain ridges. From north to south, these are the [[Tamirene]], [[Sontztei]], [[Hochest]], [[Stettehn]], [[Amnant]] and [[Frathenk]]. The average altitudes of the Amnants are around  {{convert|1000-1400|m|ft|abbr=on}}

[[File:Саблинский хребет.jpg|thumb|[[The Grand National Park]]]]
By topography and other natural features, the Amnants are divided, from north to south, into the Northern, Central and Southern parts.
